description: ActivitySim provides open activity-based travel-behaviour modelling software maintained by a consortium of planning agencies. The provider is ActivitySim consortium. Geographical and temporal coverage: ActivitySim is intended for multiple metropolitan planning organisations, with shared priorities and ongoing development. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support activity-based travel-demand simulation. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
